messages.subject: Re: Thank God for Stan!
parts:
Hi, Avi. I just thought I'd cc stan-dev on this one! And this reminds me that we (the stan teem) need to collect these examples, which I hope soon will be a list of published papers that use Stan…
See you
A

On Jul 19, 2013, at 2:02 PM, Avi Feller wrote:

> Hi Andy,
>
> I wanted to thank you again for encouraging me to implement my little project in Stan. Without going into too many of the details, I've just successfully scaled everything up to my full-fledged model, which includes several hierarchical terms of interest.
>
> Prior to Stan, I had only been able to successfully implement a non-hierarchical version of this model (via data augmentation and a few other things). And I thought it was pretty quick all things considered---for an ESS of 1,000, I needed to run the chain for 5-6 hours.
>
> By contrast, it takes about 10 minutes to run the non-hierarchical version in Stan, an increase of ~30 times! Moreover, it was incredibly easy to include hierarchical effects, which only adds a few minutes to the computation time.
>
> Bob is going to add a few things that will speed this up even more as part of Stan 2.0 (specifically, actual derivatives for the 'softmax' function). But I'm already thrilled with the results.
>
> So, in short, thank you for Stan!
>
> Avi
